# NEW 2026-11-23 v22.0 Module 1: Teutonic, Livonian & Hospitaller Military Orders (oe_teu_) — Military-Order Scripted Triggers (oe_teu_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v220_teu_start_laws.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True for TEU, LIV, KNI or any Catholic Military Order / Crusade-at-Sea order.
oe_teu_is_military_order = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = TEU
		has_or_had_tag = LIV
		has_or_had_tag = KNI
		has_reform = government_reform:military_order_reform
		has_reform = government_reform:crusade_sea_reform
	}
}

# Country scope. Baltic branch orders (Teutonic & Livonian).
oe_teu_is_baltic_order = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = TEU
		has_or_had_tag = LIV
	}
}

# Country scope. Mediterranean Hospitaller branch.
oe_teu_is_hospitaller_order = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = KNI
		has_reform = government_reform:crusade_sea_reform
	}
}

# Country scope. Tier 3 Pan-Christian Commandery (Balleien) network threshold.
oe_teu_has_strong_commandery_network = {
	religion = religion:catholic
	OR = {
		total_foreign_buildings_levels >= 8
		AND = {
			total_foreign_buildings_levels >= 5
			prestige >= 35
		}
		AND = {
			prestige >= 55
			modifier:diplomatic_reputation >= 2
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Tier 2 Established Commandery network threshold.
oe_teu_has_established_commandery_network = {
	religion = religion:catholic
	OR = {
		total_foreign_buildings_levels >= 4
		AND = {
			total_foreign_buildings_levels >= 2
			prestige >= 20
		}
		prestige >= 35
	}
}

# Country scope. Tier 1 Modest Commandery network threshold.
oe_teu_has_modest_commandery_network = {
	religion = religion:catholic
	OR = {
		total_foreign_buildings_levels >= 1
		prestige >= 15
		devotion >= 60
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible posture to summon Preussenreisen guest crusaders.
oe_teu_can_summon_preussenreisen = {
	oe_teu_is_military_order = yes
	OR = {
		is_subject = no
		AND = {
			has_or_had_tag = LIV
			at_war = yes
		}
	}
	OR = {
		at_war = yes
		army_tradition >= 15
		devotion >= 65
	}
}
